description: Daily impressions of the property in Google's generative AI features (AI Overviews and AI Mode) from the Search Console "Generative AI features" report, imported into Organiq (this report is not in the Search Analytics API and has no clicks). kind = all (default), text or multimodal. Returns totals for the period and the comparison with change, the daily series and the import coverage (firstDate, lastDate, importedAt). hasData=false when nothing was imported for the property. Requires the GEO add-on (error plan_limit otherwise). Use for GEO: "how visible are we inside AI Overviews", trend after content changes, share vs classic impressions (compare with get_site_summary). / Impressões na Visão geral de IA e no Modo IA (relatório importado), com série diária e comparação.

days.description: Window in days ending on the last imported date (default 28).

endDate.description: Explicit range yyyy-mm-dd (default end = last imported date).

kind.description: Search type of the report (default all).

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id.

name: get_genai_impressions
title: Impressions in AI Overviews / AI Mode
